recap.text: Bianca was a Boer goat who became a Hellspawn Familiar the size of a draft horse with black flames and stubby wings. She pulls a cart carrying Carl and likes grapes and rump pets. She reappears at level 40 the size of a large rhinoceros with a saddle and smoking wings. Prepotente mounts her, and they lift off burning in black flame.

Bianca lands riderless beside Carl at the edge of the Madness woods. She screams in fury and sets the foliage alight before following Carl's point toward the goddess and the Dream castle. Bianca intercepts two meteors from Larracos with a black and purple light, leaving a streak of purple smoke. She follows the deflected meteor as it enters the ball.

Bianca, a hellspawn familiar, pursues the Lady Dominators through a smelting room and into a room with piles of Toddler Cocaine. The powder kicks into a cloud and renders Bianca strung out. Prepotente pulls off the track to administer aid before she perishes.

beats.headline: The goat pulling the cart
beats.text: Subject was a goat once. Specifically a Boer goat, one of the Shepherd's. She is now a Hellspawn Familiar the size of a draft horse, with black flames coming off her back and a stubby pair of wings coming out of it, and at present she is pulling the cart that carries Carl, whom she helped to save. Her own description calls her kind scary as shit. The cat reports that she liked being petted on the rump and loved grapes.
beats.gist: Bianca is a draft horse-sized Hellspawn Familiar who was once a Boer goat.

beats.headline: Wings and a saddle
beats.text: Subject reappears in the clearing at level 40, up from 33 a few days earlier, the size of a large rhinoceros, with a full set of black smoking wings and a saddle. The dinosaurs screech; the clearing heats up. Ten levels short of full size. Prepotente mounts, informs her she may not eat any of them, and informs her further that they are no longer tethered to the ground or to moonlight. She lifts off with him, both burning in black flame.
beats.gist: Bianca reappears in the clearing at level 40, the size of a large rhinoceros.

beats.headline: Landing without a rider
beats.text: Subject landed beside Crawler Carl at the edge of the Madness woods, riderless. Prepotente was not on her back. He had been on his way to shield the army, and Carl's guess was that the Goddess Eris had lifted him off the field with everyone else. Subject screamed in fury, jumped up and down hard enough to set the foliage alight, and hissed at Carl as though he had done it. Carl pointed southeast, toward the goddess and the Dream castle. Subject left a line of fire on the ground going that way.
beats.gist: Bianca lands riderless beside Carl, screams in fury, and leaves a line of fire toward the castle.

beats.headline: Two meteors
beats.text: Two meteors came out of Larracos across the dark toward the ball. A third light, burning black and purple, intercepted both: struck the first, carried its momentum into the second and knocked it off course. The explosion showed what it was. Subject, injured in the blast, pivoted, fell out of sight and left a streak of purple smoke. The deflected meteor looped and went into the ball anyway. When the ball began to roll toward Larracos, subject rose again from wherever she had fallen and, after bobbing in the air a moment, followed it.
beats.gist: Two meteors leave Larracos toward the ball, but a black and purple light intercepts them.

beats.headline: Strung out
beats.text: Bianca, hellspawn familiar, pursued the Lady Dominators out of the smelting room and through the next one as instructed. The next one was dotted with piles of white powder like giant anthills, kicked into a cloud by the vehicles ahead. The powder is Toddler Cocaine. She was rendered strung out before she could lay a hoof on the target, and Prepotente pulled off the track to administer aid before she perished. The description on that powder runs to several paragraphs. She did not read it.
beats.gist: Bianca, a hellspawn familiar, is rendered strung out by Toddler Cocaine and receives aid from Prepotente.
